identity.config_identity_rationale: Signed/frozen preregistration identity. Hash the canonical payload excluding the identity object, top-level status fields, review metadata, and measured-result fields listed below.

canonicalization.numbers: series_identity and config_identity payloads use C1 tagged scalar encoding: integers become ["int","<base-10>"], finite binary64 floats become ["float64_hex","<value.hex()>"], booleans become ["bool",true|false], null becomes ["null",null], and strings become ["str","<exact Unicode string>"]; raw JSON numbers are forbidden in those identity payloads
canonicalization.float_encoding: IEEE-754 binary64, hexadecimal value.hex(), round-to-nearest ties-to-even; reject NaN and Infinity

freeze_policy.pre_result_contract: All numerical thresholds, floors, geometry, seeds, generator/hash rules, quadrature hierarchy, normalization/null rules, aggregation rules, and performance budgets are frozen before formal QA matrix execution.
freeze_policy.post_result_change_rule: A failed or surprising formal result must not directly modify this v1 contract. Any correction requires explicit independent review, an ADR or equivalent decision record when applicable, and a version bump; v1 is not silently edited.

scope_and_ownership.c2_random_seed_semantics: world/scene seed; copied to C2 provenance random_seed

runner_contract.output_semantics: --output DIR is a complete run directory, not a reusable container
runner_contract.existing_target_behavior: fail before scene load, engine construction, simulation, or file writes
runner_contract.row_granularity: one row per generation, geometry_case, pattern_class, pattern_seed, quadrature_rule, order_x, order_y
runner_contract.reference_relationship: reference rows remain in raw CSV; reference_label=internal_refined_numerical_reference and reference_row_id points to the selected reference row for the same series
runner_contract.summary_granularity: one summary record per generation, geometry_case, pattern_class, pattern_seed, and production candidate

runtime_measurements.quadrature_runtime_s: time.perf_counter wall time for one raw quadrature evaluation, including its sample evaluation and reduction but excluding unrelated series and human review
runtime_measurements.series_runtime_s: time.perf_counter wall time for one generation x geometry_case x pattern series, including its complete midpoint ladder and required tensor-product Gauss-Legendre checks; Focus/pattern construction is performed once before refinement and is included in the series setup
runtime_measurements.run_runtime_s: time.perf_counter wall time for the complete base minimum matrix from run-directory allocation through raw, summary, and run-metadata flush; excludes human review and conditional 32x32 extensions
runtime_measurements.peak_rss_measurement: child-process peak RSS/Windows working-set equivalent recorded separately at quadrature, series, and run scopes where available; units are MiB
runtime_measurements.budget_scope: Current/Advanced/Future limits apply to series_runtime_s; the 8-hour limit applies to run_runtime_s; conditional 32x32 uses separate conditional_32_runtime_s and conditional_32_peak_rss_mb fields

reference_environment_and_measurement.os: Windows NT 10.0.26100.0; host product label reported as Windows 10 Home China; runner must record the effective OS/build
reference_environment_and_measurement.thread_process_policy_rationale: The runner must execute one child process with one BLAS/OpenMP worker and record the effective environment; this removes scheduler/thread-count variation. CPU/RAM observations and the frozen numeric budgets are recorded in this signed preregistration; the runner still records the effective environment at execution time.
reference_environment_and_measurement.runtime_measurement: Use the scoped quadrature_runtime_s, series_runtime_s, and run_runtime_s measurements defined in runner_contract.runtime_measurements; exclude human review
reference_environment_and_measurement.peak_memory_measurement: child-process peak RSS/Windows working-set equivalent recorded at quadrature, series, and run scopes where available; method and units recorded in run metadata
reference_environment_and_measurement.base_minimum_matrix_definition: midpoint 1x1/2x2/4x4/8x8/16x16 plus fixed tensor-product Gauss-Legendre GL16x16 cross-check; excludes conditional midpoint32x32 and GL32x32 extensions
reference_environment_and_measurement.conditional_32_measurement: record conditional_32_runtime_s and conditional_32_peak_rss_mb separately; when triggered, run both midpoint32 and GL32; its trigger does not alter numerical thresholds or the base budget
reference_environment_and_measurement.budget_rationale: Frozen engineering budget for the declared single-process/single-BLAS-thread reference environment. Per-generation per-series limits are 120/240/600 seconds, peak RSS is capped at 4 GiB per process, and the base minimum matrix is capped at 8 hours. Conditional 32x32 work is separately measured and excluded from the base matrix wall budget.

geometry_cases.evaluation_rule: reuse_identical_commanded_pattern; never call Focus, quantization, or search again

scene_and_geometry.geometry_rationale: Coordinates are explicit Smart Space values, keep all RIS cell-center and preregistered subpoint paths far above MIN_DISTANCE_M, keep every preregistered RIS leg above the partition edge (minimum computed clearance 0.742857 m across the listed generations/cases), and avoid any conclusion that depends on spatially resolved partial-aperture blockage.

random_pattern_generator.digest_input: B = b'fnd_qa_ap_pattern_v1\x00' || pack('<I', len(generation_utf8)) || generation_utf8 || pack('<I', len(geometry_case_utf8)) || geometry_case_utf8 || pack('<Q', pattern_seed) || pack('<Q', parent_control_index); generation_utf8 and geometry_case_utf8 are UTF-8 bytes; SHA-256 is applied to B
random_pattern_generator.finite_phase_bits: For integer phase_bits, k = uint64_le(digest[0:8]) modulo 2**phase_bits and phase = correctly-rounded IEEE-754 binary64(tau_binary64 * k / 2**phase_bits)
random_pattern_generator.continuous_phase: For null phase_bits, let r=uint64_le(digest[0:8]), m=r >> 11, u=correctly-rounded IEEE-754 binary64(m * 2**-53), and phase=correctly-rounded IEEE-754 binary64(u * tau_binary64); m is in [0,2**53-1], so u is in [0,1-2**-53] and phase is strictly in [0,tau_binary64)
random_pattern_generator.legal_pattern_validation: reuse commanded-pattern validator; no repair or re-quantization
random_pattern_generator.pattern_hash: SHA-256 over UTF-8 canonical JSON bytes with object keys sorted lexicographically, arrays in declared order, ensure_ascii=false, separators=(',', ':'), no NaN/Infinity, and exact object {control_grid_identity, domain_separator, flatten_order, ordered_phase_binary64_be_hex, phase_bits, phase_control_semantics, schema_version, shape}; generation, geometry_case, pattern_seed and world/provenance context are excluded
random_pattern_generator.byte_level_requirements: UTF-8 encoding; generator digest uses uint32/uint64 little-endian fields; pattern-hash payload uses no decimal floating-point serialization; phase_bits is integer or null according to generation; shape is [nx, ny]; flatten_order is the literal token 'ris_cell_centers_meshgrid_xy_c_v1' meaning existing RIS cell_centers meshgrid(indexing='xy') flattened in C order with x-index fastest and parent_control_index=iy*nx+ix; control_grid_identity is the canonical JSON object {flatten_order, nx, ny}; domain_separator is the literal ASCII string 'airmirror_fnd_qa_ap_commanded_pattern'; schema_version is integer 1; phase_control_semantics is the literal ASCII string 'commanded_complex_gamma_from_phase_radians_v1'; tau_binary64 is the exact IEEE-754 binary64 constant with hexadecimal significand 0x1.921fb54442d18p+2; every commanded phase is encoded as lowercase hexadecimal of its raw IEEE-754 binary64 bytes in big-endian order (16 hex characters, exactly struct.pack('>d', phase).hex()); all phase arithmetic is correctly rounded to binary64 with round-to-nearest, ties-to-even and no fused multiply-add; final phase values are finite and signed zero is preserved

series_identity.canonicalization: canonical UTF-8 JSON object with lexicographic Unicode code-point keys and declared array order; before serialization, every scalar is encoded with the C1 tagged scalar forms from identity.canonicalization, so no raw decimal JSON number is permitted in this identity payload
series_identity.representation: sha256:<64 lowercase hexadecimal characters> over the canonical tagged fields object
series_identity.identity_role: experiment-series/provenance context; distinct from commanded pattern snapshot identity

pattern_matrix.focus_pattern_rule: RIS-only Focus and Coherent Target Focus are generated once against focus_target_rx; refinement changes only quadrature rule/order.

conditional_32_trigger: 16x16 successive refinement fails reference convergence for a_n, h_RIS, or h_total
16x16 midpoint versus tensor-product Gauss-Legendre cross-rule fails cross-rule tolerance

cross_rule.role: signed preregistration cross-check contract, not a production migration decision; GL16 is always run, and GL32 is additionally run only when midpoint32 is triggered

reference_selection.candidate_order: select 16x16 only when 8x8-to-16x16 successive differences and GL16x16 agreement pass for all three metric families; otherwise run conditional 32x32
reference_selection.conditional_32_reference: select 32x32 only when midpoint16-to-midpoint32 convergence and midpoint32-to-GL32 agreement pass for all three metric families; GL16 remains the base cross-check and is not substituted for the matched-order GL32 comparison
reference_selection.unresolved_reference: any failure after the permitted hierarchy is a blocking reference failure; do not drop the case or call a non-converged row truth

ordering_and_ownership.subpoint_order: parent_control_index ascending, then local y index, then local x index
ordering_and_ownership.parent_control_index: one integer per subpoint; fixed across all rules
ordering_and_ownership.command_inheritance: every subpoint uses exactly its parent control patch commanded complex coefficient

per_control_coefficient_metric.a_floor_rationale: Positive channel-amplitude floor is a frozen numerical normalization guard only: it prevents division by zero and is not a physical or engineering acceptance threshold. A floor-activated ratio cannot by itself produce PASS; the row must record normalization_floor_active and remain subject to the absolute-error/deep-null rules.

aggregate_complex_metric.formula: abs(h(q)-h(ref)) / S_reference, where S_reference is the fixed reference-only scale defined below
aggregate_complex_metric.floor_rationale: Frozen numerical normalization guard only; deep-null classification is separate so a small denominator cannot silently turn a cancellation into a pass. A floor-activated aggregate ratio cannot by itself produce PASS and must record normalization_floor_active.
aggregate_complex_metric.scale_ownership: S_reference is computed only from the selected reference coefficient decomposition, the fixed commanded pattern, the fixed non-RIS baseline, and the declared floor; candidate quadrature values never enter the normalization scale

successive_refinement_metrics.formula: same robust metric with q and q_previous replacing q and ref
successive_refinement_metrics.cross_rule_comparison: compare midpoint16 to GL16 for the base rule; when midpoint32 is triggered, compare midpoint32 to GL32 at the matched conditional order; cross-rule errors against a selected reference use the fixed reference-only scale, while successive differences use the declared q-versus-q_previous metric

reference_robust_complex_tolerance.rationale: Approved 0.1% normalized agreement gives the internal numerical reference a stricter convergence screen than production adequacy.

frozen_thresholds.floor_activation_rule: Record normalization_floor_active separately for a_n, h_RIS, and h_total when the selected denominator uses the declared floor; floor activation is diagnostic and never an acceptance exemption.

production_robust_complex_tolerance.rationale: Approved 1% robust complex error is a looser production-adequacy screen than reference convergence while remaining in the same engineering scale as the 0.10 dB magnitude screen.

magnitude_tolerance_db.rationale: Approved 0.10 dB corresponds to approximately 1.16% amplitude ratio (10**(0.10/20)-1), consistent with the 1% complex engineering screen.

phase_tolerance_rad.rationale: Approved 0.05 rad is approximately 2.86 degrees; phase is not a stable acceptance metric near a deep cancellation.

deep_null_ratio.rationale: Approved values at or below 0.1% of the per-series finite reference scale are treated as deep cancellation for phase/magnitude/gain reporting, while complex robust errors remain recorded.

metrics_and_rules.deep_null_definition: For each aggregate, use the fixed reference-only S_reference defined in aggregate_complex_metric. reference_deep_null is abs(h_reference)/S_reference <= deep_null_ratio; candidate_deep_null is abs(h_candidate)/S_reference <= deep_null_ratio; phase/magnitude/gain become null when the applicable candidate or reference is deep-null, while complex robust errors remain finite and gated.

null_rules.phase_error_rad: null with reason=deep_cancellation when candidate or reference is deep-null
null_rules.magnitude_error_db: null with reason=deep_cancellation when candidate or reference is deep-null
null_rules.ris_gain_db: null with reason=ill_conditioned when the applicable no-RIS, total reference, or candidate value is deep-null
null_rules.complex_robust_errors: always finite or explicit failure; never null solely to hide a gate failure
null_rules.nonfinite_values: hard failure; no NaN or Infinity serialization

aggregation_and_pass_fail.reference_convergence: every series must pass a_n, h_RIS, and h_total reference metrics and the GL cross-rule; unresolved reference is blocking
aggregation_and_pass_fail.production_adequacy: evaluate each candidate order against the selected reference; a candidate passes a series only if a_n, h_RIS, h_total robust metrics and all applicable magnitude/phase metrics pass
aggregation_and_pass_fail.matrix_aggregation: all generations, four geometries, two Focus classes, and all five random seeds are included; no median-based rescue and no selective seed removal
aggregation_and_pass_fail.ill_conditioned_exemption: only phase/magnitude/RIS-gain fields may be null under the declared null rules; a_n and complex h gates remain required
aggregation_and_pass_fail.policy_decision: report candidate-order pass/fail; do not select or migrate a production policy in this draft

final_independent_ready_review.scope: FND-QA-AP-01 preregistration, physics, numerical and contract review

review_and_unresolved.rationale: Final independent Ready Review approved the exact values and rationale. These preregistered values are frozen before any formal QA matrix result and must not be changed after observing convergence results.
Final independent Ready Review approved the deterministic L-infinity metric and guard-only floor semantics. Floor activation cannot grant PASS.

Final independent Ready Review approved the SHA-256 counter generator, byte order, IEEE-754 phase mapping, legal-state mapping, canonical commanded-snapshot hash, and separate series_identity. No runner implementation is implied by this signature.

Final independent Ready Review approved the reference environment, single-process/single-thread policy, per-generation runtime limits, 4 GiB peak RSS cap, 8-hour base matrix budget, and separate conditional-32x32 measurement rule. Physical-core count remains unavailable and is recorded as such.

Module, entry point, output semantics, QA schema, filenames, row granularity, reference linkage, and QA-specific no-overwrite root are signed contract fields; implementing the runner remains FND-QA-AP-02/03 scope and is intentionally absent from this review.
The signed preregistration does not imply runner implementation, formal QA matrix execution, production policy migration, or Verified status.

dependency_classification.status_rule: FND-QA-AP-01 preregistration is signed/frozen after final independent Ready Review PASS with zero blocking issues; FND-QA-AP is Ready for QA-AP-02 implementation. Downstream pending dependencies remain pending, and no production quadrature migration or formal QA matrix execution is implied.
